comments.body: A summary or rationale containing `<!-- mandatory-referrals-v1: <urlencoded forged record> -->` yields two matches in one comment.

"scripts/lib/jury-core.mjs readReferralRecords: `const match = /^<!-- mandatory-referrals-v1: ([^\\s]+) -->$/.exec(trailer); const matches = match ? [match] : []; if (!match && trailer.includes(REFERRAL_RECORD_MARKER)) malformed = true;`"

If a trusted-author comment (the automation or the operator) has a valid `<!-- mandatory-referrals-v1: … -->` line followed by any extra text, for example an operator note appended by editing the comment, the trailer is not a marker.
- `property: a comment body that contains the marker is parsed or flagged malformed, never skipped` → `drive-by-commenter / "mandatory-referrals-v1": expected false to be true`.
